bayts.text: Be one who conceals harm and misery: you shall attain your aim and rise above your generation, O student!
Do not multiply complaint: be steadfast, until people think you are favoured with blessings.
For knowledge is not given to one who fears hunger: it is to the patient servant that our Lord inspires it.
Persevere in the study of the sciences, reading: woe to the dullard who, for hunger, mumbles hesitantly!
Do not busy yourself with provision, for the Lord of creatures guarantees the provision of whoever studies.
And fear God, guarding His religion, for knowledge is not attained by the guilty sinner.
Keep away from full-bosomed maidens and beauties, and withdraw: if you draw near them you will not be safe from ruin.
Do not buy this world with the Other, O young man: whoever sells light for darkness will regret it.
